Kings, Queens, Jacks... indecent. Cover them up.
I shall be writing a strongly worded letter.
Another show saved from bad taste.
I've drafted new rules. Longer ones.
No Hearts in my convent. Not one.
I said a hundred prayers for your failure.
Your troupe is now a write-off.
I never close a case for good.
Clubs are poaching tools. Hand them over.
Slippery as hares, the lot of you.
I followed your wagon tracks for three towns.
Do the same trick twice and I'm leaving.
I came back to see if you'd improved. Doubtful.
Choose one style. Commit to it.
Every card that crosses this stage pays a toll.
Keep the change. I insist. Ugh.
Play your favourite again and your purse is mine.
Mine, mine, all of it mine.
I counted my coins. Some were yours.
I see everything. You'll see a little less.
Didn't see that coming. Embarrassing, for a spy.
I knew your hand before you did.
I've been watching you since the last town.
Under this mask, I'm smiling. A little.
Did you think I'd forget your face?
Lights out after the first act.
In the dark, everyone's a fool.
The dark is back. So am I.
Nobility prefers not to be seen with commoners.
My family never forgets a slight.
Protocol: five cards. No more, no less.
Protocol permits applause. Just this once.
I've amended the protocol. Against you.
I've taken the liberty of removing a card, sir.
Very good, sir. Very good indeed.
I've taken the liberty of returning, sir.
Nice cards. Shame if they wandered off.
Fine, fine. Have your pockets back.
Thanks for the show. And the wallet.
Didn't I rob you already? Once more, then.
Pride goes before a fall. Each hand, a little lower.
I've come to hear your confession.
Half for you, half for the Duchy.
Even half of you was too much.
The Duchy thanks you for your contribution.
Fresh tricks. I didn't expect that.
I've seen all your cards. Boring.
I remember every card you've ever played.
Back already? No, I'm back. Hurry!
One hand, darling. Make it count.
Exquisite. You may kiss the ring.
One chance, and you missed it.
I'll grant you one more hand. Only one.
The whole Carnevale is watching. Impress me.
Grand dukes do not lose twice.
Let's see who's really in your troupe.
Every one of them earned their place.
A troupe is only as good as its weakest mask.
I've picked my favourite. To silence.
Confess. Give me one of your Jesters.
The tribunal has reopened your case.
Let's shuffle the order of things.
A miracle. Or a very good trick.
That one. Play that one. I insist.
The Queen requests a command performance.
Every stage in Italy is mine. This one too.
...Bravo. I never learned how you do it.
Sold. The whole troupe, for a song.
I bought your last stage. I'll buy this one too.
